run_job: run a Docker job on Hugging Face Hub with a custom image and command
list_jobs: list running or all jobs on Hugging Face Hub with optional filters and output format
stream_job_logs: stream real-time logs from a running job on Hugging Face Hub
schedule_job: schedule a recurring job on Hugging Face Hub with a cron expression
run_uv_script: run a UV Python script with inline dependencies on Hugging Face Hub infrastructure
